text:
maya_s: Hey team — Acme's POC starts next Monday. They need a sandbox with least-priv RBAC, ephemeral keys for contractors, and the ability to hit a Dedicated pool for load tests. Who can provision and outline steps?

ravi_se: I can handle the access side. Quick clarification: we do hosted API keys for dev access + a Dedicated pool for perf tests, and private/VPC only if they ask later?

maya_s: Correct. For this phase: 1) invite flow for 6 contractors + 2 PMs, 2) roles: contractor-invoke (no billing), contractor-read (logs/console), pm-admin, 3) invites auto-expire after 14d, 4) ephemeral API keys rotating every 24h. Also pricing question — can we offer a 3-week Dedicated trial with a small commit discount for them?

lena_sec: Security checklist items: audit logging + request tracing enabled, customer KMS if they move to private, IP allowlist for Dedicated pool. Ephemeral keys are fine (short-lived tokens + rotation). For invites, we need an org policy rule that enforces invite_expiry. @ravi_se can you map the roles to our existing role templates?

ravi_se: Proposed mapping: contractor-invoke -> invoke_only (no console/billing), contractor-read -> read_only_logs, pm-admin -> workspace_admin (invite/approve). I'll prepare a terraform snippet for the workspace policy and role bindings.

infra-bot: deploy-job: role-policy-template created at /infra/poc-templates/1945678901-role-policy.json

alex_cust: One customer ask: can contractors use hosted keys without seeing other orgs' artifacts? They want strict isolation per POC.

ravi_se: Yes — create a dedicated workspace scoped to Acme. Hosted API keys are workspace-scoped. Contractors get workspace-limited roles. For Dedicated tests we'll route traffic from that workspace to the Dedicated pool via a routing policy.

jon_sales: Pricing note: @maya_s we can offer a 3-week discounted commit — finance preliminary ok with 30% off prorated monthly min. Need formal approval from deals.

priya_pm: Confirming invite expiry of 14 days OK. For ephemeral keys we'll enforce TTL=24h and provide a refresh endpoint + sample client. I'll add a short onboarding checklist and a one-pager.

lena_sec: Also call out: no long-term keys stored in plaintext, rotate service accounts weekly, enable request_id tracing for audits. We'll want the KMS key policy ready if they move to private.

maya_s: :thumbsup: Awesome. @ravi_se can you post the step-by-step runbook? I also need instructions to request Dedicated capacity for a 2-day high-load window in week 2. I'll coordinate with Acme SRE for IP allowlist.

ravi_se: Runbook (high level):
1) create workspace `acme-poc`
2) create roles and set `invite_expiry=14d`
3) enable `ephemeral_key_policy` TTL=24h
4) generate hosted API keys scoped to workspace for dev access
5) submit Dedicated pool request form (2-day burst) — link: https://redwood.ops/dedicated-requests
6) optional: stand up private/VPC later and exchange KMS policy
I just opened the ops ticket for Dedicated.

infra-bot: ops-ticket: created TICKET-9901 for dedicated-pool request (2-day burst)

maya_s: Thanks — forwarding to Acme now. I'll attach the invite template and onboarding checklist after Ravi posts the terraform and the client snippet.

ravi_se: Pasted invite template:

```
Invite link: https://redwood.ai/invite/acme-poc
Role: contractor-invoke
Expires: 14d
```

Will follow up with terraform policy and a short runbook snippet in this thread.

jon_sales: Approving the 30% discount for the 3-week commit (finance confirmed). Maya, please loop in account mgmt for the contract addendum.
